interface.title: BioInterface — Assay Library (AI Interface for Biopharma Lab Automation)
interface.field: Laboratory automation for biopharma/CDMO, genomics/NGS, drug discovery/HTS and core lab methods
interface.stage_of_work: Planning and running assays, then QC review of instrument output
interface.what_it_is_for: Browse a library of automatable assay protocols, plan and simulate a robot run, generate PyLabRobot-style code, and check uploaded instrument output against each assay's acceptance criteria with pass/fail flags.

data.note: The assay library is built in (fields include Biopharma/CDMO and Genomics/NGS, 58 assays). Run review used the uploaded fixtures test_qubit.csv (detected as qubit_csv, 5 results) and test_tapestation_compact.csv (detected as tapestation_csv_compact, 4 results). Both were checked against the acceptance criteria of NGS_006 Qubit dsDNA HS. A generated PyLabRobot file (bio_002_pylabrobot.py) was downloaded and read.

features.name: Step-by-step run setup wizard with code export
features.general: Guided setup in several steps: choose a procedure, optionally a layout, then how material moves between instruments. Review a summary of time and resources, then export runnable automation code or launch a simulation.
features.specific: New Experiment Run stepper: 1 What to run (library assay or plain-English custom protocol), 2 Pick deck (or placeholders), 3 Deployment cards (Manual / Robotic arm / Rail robot / Scheduler), 4 Review & run (metrics, pipeline preview, Code format + Download PyLabRobot, Save as Template, Run Pipeline). In this run a click on the Robotic arm card did not carry through: Step 4 still showed deployment 'manual'. Next buttons sometimes need a second click.
steps: pick an assay from the Field/Assay dropdowns
pick a deployment card (check that Step 4 shows it)
review summary metrics and expand Pipeline preview
serves_tasks: Configure the instrument layout and how samples move between instruments
Review the run plan and export it as code
Launch a simulation straight from the finished run plan

features.name: Simulated pipeline runner with step status cards
features.general: Run a procedure as a list of timed steps, each labelled with its instrument. Show overall progress, lock the settings while it runs, and record the run so later steps can use it.
features.specific: Experimental Pipeline Runner: Select assay, Deployment radio, Simulation speed slider (1x real time … 100x … instant), then ▶ Run Pipeline (Simulated). Shows the Run ID, Progress/Completed/Running/Pending counters and per-step cards (liquid_handler, analyst, incubator, plate_reader, fluorometer). In both the original session and the replay the view never reached a completed state (0%, every step 'running'), yet the run was recorded as completed in the Upload Run Data run picker.
steps: watch the step cards and counters
pick the recorded run in Upload Run Data
serves_tasks: Start a simulated run with settings chosen on the runner itself
Launch a simulation straight from the finished run plan

features.name: Instrument-file ingestion with acceptance-criteria verdict
features.general: Attach a raw instrument export to a finished run. The tool detects the file format and pulls out per-sample values, then checks each one against the procedure's written criteria. You get an overall badge and a per-sample pass / fail / not-evaluated table with the rule used.
features.specific: Upload Run Data: Select pipeline run, then a drop-file uploader (CSV/XLS/XLSX/TXT/JSON) that shows the Detected format (qubit_csv, tapestation_csv_compact). Ingest File gives an 'Acceptance criteria evaluation' badge (PARTIAL / ALL SAMPLES PASS) and a table of Sample, Value, Units, Verdict, Criteria and Rule(s). An expander lists all criteria with their measured values.
steps: upload an instrument file and check the detected format
read the verdict badge and per-sample table
remove the file and ingest another for the same run
serves_tasks: Attach an instrument output file to a finished run and get a per-sample pass/fail verdict
Check a second instrument file for the same run

features.name: Tabbed protocol dossier
features.general: One page per procedure: headline metrics, then tabs for step-by-step instructions, physical layout, materials, quality criteria and regulatory references.
features.specific: Assay Detail: Select Assay, badges (difficulty, workbench, biosafety, analyst steps, autonomy level), metric cards (Robot Time, Total Duration, Samples/Run, Sample Volume, Detection), and tabs: Robot Steps (analyst steps highlighted), Deck Layout table, Instruments & Reagents (plus an AutoMATE 96 head recommendation), Acceptance Criteria, Regulatory.
serves_tasks: Read the full record of one procedure: steps, layout, materials, quality criteria and regulations

features.name: Multi-item comparison with bar and radar charts
features.general: Pick two or more items in a tag selector and compare them in a table, bar charts of key quantities and a normalised radar chart.
features.specific: Compare Assays: a multiselect of assays feeds a comparison table, Robot Active Time and Throughput (Samples/Run) bar charts coloured by difficulty, and a Radar Comparison over Robot Steps, Sample uL, Robot min, Reagents, Instruments and Analyst Steps.

serves_tasks: Compare several procedures side by side on time and throughput

features.general: Summarise across a catalogue where a person must step in during automated procedures: headline counts, then a per-procedure list of the manual steps.
features.specific: Analyst Intervention Points: metric cards Total analyst steps, Assays with analyst steps and Fully automated (11 / 8 / 0 for Genomics / NGS), then one expander per assay. The expanders were not opened in either session.
